payout_quote: Amerant At Work Program: earn a $300 cash bonus on a Value Checking account when you are employed by an active Amerant commercial client, open (or hold) the account, set up a monthly direct deposit, maintain a $500 balance for three consecutive statement cycles, and enroll in e-statements and online banking.
timing: Bonus credited within 45 days of meeting all requirements; account must remain open and unrestricted through the credit date.
steps: Confirm your employer is an active commercial client of Amerant Bank (ask HR or check with the bank).
Open a Value Checking account via https://www.amerantbank.com/atwork/ with the $50 minimum deposit within 7 days.
Set up a monthly direct deposit to the account and maintain a $500 balance for three consecutive statement cycles.
Enroll in e-statements and online banking.
Keep the account open and unrestricted; the $300 bonus credits within 45 days of meeting all requirements (reported on 1099-INT).
catches: TARGETED: available only to employees of companies that are active commercial clients of Amerant; employment must be verifiable — most users will not qualify.
No general-public checking bonus exists on amerantbank.com (the Special Offers page lists only CD promos); prior public Value Checking bonuses (up to $500) are expired.

Value Checking requires a $50 minimum opening deposit within 7 days; monthly direct deposit + $500 maintained balance for three consecutive statement cycles + e-statements + online banking enrollment.
Not combinable with other promotions; one account per participant; account must remain open and unrestricted through credit.
Bonus reported as interest income (1099-INT); program may be modified or discontinued at any time (no end date published).
biggest_catch: This is a TARGETED offer — only employees of companies that are active commercial clients of Amerant qualify. There is no public checking bonus on amerantbank.com.
eligibility: Employees of Amerant's active commercial-client companies only (verifiable employment); 18+.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23 against the official amerantbank.com/atwork program page. The $300 figure is official and matches the catalog. The route must surface the targeted-only eligibility loudly — it is NOT a public offer. Do not present it as earnable by anyone outside the employer program. App links left null.
